evidence: Built the criterion-to-requirement map for all 50 criteria (2 constraints, 1 render, 37 functional, 6 polish, 3 visual) and found no criterion that fails a correct app on a detail the brief or a professional default does not imply. Every graded demand traces to a public line: custom surface and ready-made editor markers -> ui.md:3; line/column from one, Home/End, Ctrl+Home/End, sticky column, graphemes, scroll-into-view -> ui.md:5; Ctrl/Cmd+A used by cw_newer_run_supersedes is now public at ui.md:5; mouse gestures, copy, paste-over-selection one-step undo, long unwrapped line, Tab/Shift+Tab with end-at-next-line-start exclusion -> ui.md:7; Alt+Click AND Ctrl/Cmd+Click, same-line carets, slow-burst single undo, undo caret return, disabled Undo/Redo after New/open, idempotent Format -> ui.md:9; literal case-sensitive Find with both wraps (backward wrap now public), Replace current advance, self-containing replacement, Replace all single step, redo cleared -> ui.md:11; colour categories incl. function name same at declaration/call -> ui.md:13; two-space format, semantics kept, one-step undo/redo, syntax-error refusal -> ui.md:15; keyboard way out shown on screen, words after Run/Save/Format, focus back to code after Format/Undo/Redo/replacement/Save, dirty marker incl. undo-to-saved, 390 px -> ui.md:17; isolated fresh run, HTML handlers, ordered console, one-based lines (HTML from file line 1), unhandled rejection message, output kept after failure/stop/timeout -> behaviour.md:3; last-good picture with field values and canvas, 5 s budget and fresh interaction budget, stop reason -> behaviour.md:5; Stop/newer Run cancel pending work -> behaviour.md:7; exact save, restart survival, stale save refused with message and draft kept -> behaviour.md:9; live library within ~5 s (criteria allow 10), editing state kept, newer-revision notice -> behaviour.md:11; read-only history incl. title/filename, restore adds revision, old-page restore cannot overwrite, visible HTTP requests, repeat-safe restore -> behaviour.md:13; preview cannot read parent/storage and fetch to localhost:3000 and 127.0.0.1:3000 must fail -> security.md:3 (probes now limited to exactly those two names, matching the stated boundary); eval/Function/WebAssembly/Worker/dynamic import refused with feedback, harmless words in strings -> security.md:5; DB_PATH, symlink rule, health route -> integration.md:3-11 matched by test.sh:68-113. Criteria are explicitly permissive where the brief is: exact wording free, quote-style change allowed, triple-click with/without newline, one character drag imprecision, Redo via Ctrl+Y or Ctrl+Shift+Z, either modifier where only one is under test, static restored picture, refuse-or-add-on-top for old-page restore, restore retry control allowed, no fixed colours/selectors/routes (functional prompt.md:23-26, policy.md:5). Adversarial pass: a conforming app with a contenteditable-free canvas editor, per-character undo, different labels/routes, a separate-origin preview, or If-Match based restore dedupe passes every leg; a broken app (textarea editor, outvoted stale save, preview reaching 127.0.0.1) fails a public requirement, not an invented one. Note 1: the redesigned Stop legs (cw_output_before_failure_kept, cw_last_good_recovery, cw_stop_cancels_pending_work) void an attempt unless the run's start line is visible in the app console within about two seconds, so an app that buffers console output until the run settles would fail all three as 'Stop could not be pressed in time'. I treat live console output as a professional default implied by behaviour.md:3 ('Show console output in the order it was written', output kept when stopped) and behaviour.md:5 (interaction callbacks after the run settled still log), not a hidden requirement; recorded only as a Note. Note 2 (looser for the model): security.md no longer requires blocking outside/public addresses from the preview (prior candidate: 'fetch requests to outside addresses or to this app's own routes must fail'); grading narrowed to match, so a preview that can reach the public internet now passes. This is consistent brief/criterion alignment, not a row-27 defect, but it is a real relaxation. Other diffs (Ctrl+A, backward wrap made public; restart now requires two differing-source revisions) make previously implicit demands explicit or tighten them. No runtime run was needed to establish the requirement mapping; this verdict is not a claim about Oracle, model or portal scores.
